verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Granola serves an llms.txt at docs.granola.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes its docs and help center as markdown (.md) pages an agent can consume. The docs also say this llms.txt advertises a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec under "OpenAPI Specs". Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and no independent community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://docs.granola.ai/llms.txt # Granola Docs & Help Center
